newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares tumble on Yadav bail rejection.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares tumble on Yadav bail rejection.

text.p: Delhi share prices fell sharply lower following news that the Patna High Court had rejected Chief Minister Laloo Prasad Yadav's appeal for anticipatory bail, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index fell 17.43 points to 883.10, moments after the news.
"The market has fallen due to rejection of anticipatory bail to Bihar Chief Minister. It is only a temporary fall," said Manoj Choraria of brokers Choraria Investments.
The Patna High Court on Thursday rejected Yadav's application in a $280 million corruption scandal case for "anticipatory bail" to avert arrest by federal police.
Yadav says he is innocent in the case which has divided Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's United Front coalition, which is debating whether to admit Yadav's Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) party.
